# 透過 HSV 演算法在螢幕繪製平滑流動的彩虹漸層
def hsv_to_rgb565(h, s, v):
    # h: 0~359, s: 0~100, v: 0~100 -> 回傳 RGB565 整數
    hi = (h // 60) % 6
    f = (h % 60) * 1000 // 60
    p = v * (100 - s) // 100
    q = v * (100000 - s * f) // 100000
    t = v * (100000 - s * (1000 - f)) // 100000
    
    if hi == 0: r, g, b = v, t, p
    elif hi == 1: r, g, b = q, v, p
    elif hi == 2: r, g, b = p, v, t
    elif hi == 3: r, g, b = p, q, v
    elif hi == 4: r, g, b = t, p, v
    else: r, g, b = v, p, q
    
    # 轉換為 5-6-5 格式 (0~255 轉成 5bit, 6bit, 5bit)
    r5 = (r * 31) // 100
    g6 = (g * 63) // 100
    b5 = (b * 31) // 100
    return (r5 << 11) | (g6 << 5) | b5

hue_offset = 0

while lab.running():
    # 繪製 16 條垂直漸層色塊以提高繪製效率
    for col in range(16):
        h = (hue_offset + col * 22) % 360
        color_val = hsv_to_rgb565(h, 100, 100)
        lab.display.fill_rect(col * 8, 0, 8, 128, color_val)
        
    # 螢幕中央加上文字標籤
    lab.display.fill_rect(18, 52, 92, 24, lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.text("RAINBOW", 36, 60, lab.display.WHITE)
    lab.display.show()
    
    hue_offset = (hue_offset + 8) % 360
    lab.sleep(0.05)

# 模擬小球在螢幕邊界碰撞反彈的物理運動
x = 64
y = 64
vx = 3
vy = 2
radius = 5

while lab.running():
    # 移動小球位置
    x += vx
    y += vy
    
    # X 軸邊界碰撞檢測
    if x - radius <= 0:
        x = radius
        vx = -vx
    elif x + radius >= 127:
        x = 127 - radius
        vx = -vx
        
    # Y 軸邊界碰撞檢測
    if y - radius <= 0:
        y = radius
        vy = -vy
    elif y + radius >= 127:
        y = 127 - radius
        vy = -vy
        
    # 重新繪製畫面與小球
    lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.rect(0, 0, 128, 128, lab.display.BLUE)
    lab.display.fill_rect(int(x - radius), int(y - radius), radius * 2, radius * 2, lab.display.YELLOW)
    lab.display.text("BOUNCE", 40, 8, lab.display.CYAN)
    
    lab.display.show()
    lab.sleep(0.03)

# NTP 網路校時並在螢幕顯示台灣時間電子鐘
import time
import ntptime

# 嘗試同步網路時間
lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
lab.display.text("Syncing NTP...", 12, 56, lab.display.CYAN)
lab.display.show()

try:
    ntptime.settime()
    print("NTP sync successful")
except Exception as e:
    print("NTP sync failed:", e)

colon_show = True

while lab.running():
    # 加上台灣時區偏移量 (+8 小時 = 28800 秒)
    t = time.localtime(time.time() + 8 * 3600)
    hh = "{:02d}".format(t[3])
    mm = "{:02d}".format(t[4])
    ss = "{:02d}".format(t[5])
    
    # 冒號每秒閃爍

    colon_show = not colon_show

    date_str = "{:04d}-{:02d}-{:02d}".format(t[0], t[1], t[2])

    lab.display.rect(4, 4, 120, 120, lab.display.WHITE)
    lab.display.text("TAIWAN TIME", 20, 24, lab.display.CYAN)
    lab.display.text(time_str, 28, 56, lab.display.YELLOW)
    lab.display.text(date_str, 24, 88, lab.display.GREEN)
    lab.display.show()

# 貓咪時鐘（T-QT Pro，esp32-ai-lab 版）
# 板子已由代理程式連好 Wi-Fi、初始化好螢幕，程式只管畫圖；用 lab.sleep 才能被「停止」鍵中斷。
import lab, time, ntptime
from lab.board_tqt import color

d = lab.display
BG, ORANGE, PINK = color(20, 24, 35), color(245, 145, 45), color(255, 175, 190)
WHITE, BLACK, CYAN = d.WHITE, d.BLACK, d.CYAN

try:
    ntptime.settime()            # Wi-Fi 已連好，直接校時（UTC）
    lab.log("NTP 校時完成")
except Exception as e:
    lab.log("NTP 失敗：", e)

def draw_cat(x, y, blink=False):
    d.fill_rect(x + 10, y + 2, 14, 18, ORANGE); d.fill_rect(x + 13, y + 5, 8, 12, PINK)
    d.fill_rect(x + 56, y + 2, 14, 18, ORANGE); d.fill_rect(x + 59, y + 5, 8, 12, PINK)
    d.fill_rect(x, y + 16, 80, 46, ORANGE); d.rect(x, y + 16, 80, 46, BLACK)
    if blink:
        d.hline(x + 18, y + 34, 14, BLACK); d.hline(x + 48, y + 34, 14, BLACK)
    else:
        d.fill_rect(x + 18, y + 28, 14, 12, WHITE); d.fill_rect(x + 48, y + 28, 14, 12, WHITE)
        d.fill_rect(x + 24, y + 30, 6, 8, BLACK);   d.fill_rect(x + 54, y + 30, 6, 8, BLACK)
    d.fill_rect(x + 38, y + 42, 4, 3, PINK); d.vline(x + 40, y + 45, 4, BLACK); d.hline(x + 35, y + 49, 11, BLACK)
    for dy in (37, 43):
        d.hline(x + 4, y + dy, 10, BLACK); d.hline(x + 66, y + dy, 10, BLACK)

while lab.running():                       # 不用 while True，才停得下來
    t = time.localtime(time.time() + 8 * 3600)   # 台灣 UTC+8
    d.fill(BG)
    draw_cat(24, 12, blink=(t[5] % 5 == 0))
    d.text("{:04d}/{:02d}/{:02d}".format(t[0], t[1], t[2]), 24, 82, CYAN)
    d.text("{:02d}:{:02d}:{:02d}".format(t[3], t[4], t[5]), 32, 98, WHITE)
    d.text("Wi-Fi: OK", 28, 114, CYAN)
    d.show()                                # 一定要 show 才會顯示
    lab.sleep(1)

description: 使用 lab.battery() 讀取板端鋰電池電壓。依據 3.3V~4.2V 標準區間估算剩餘百分比，並透過 lab.send 傳送監測資料。

# 讀取鋰電池電壓並在螢幕上繪製電量指示條
while lab.running():
    v = lab.battery()
    lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.text("BATTERY STATUS", 8, 12, lab.display.CYAN)
    
    if v is not None:
        # 依 3.3V (0%) 到 4.2V (100%) 計算百分比
        pct = int((v - 3.3) / (4.2 - 3.3) * 100)
        pct = max(0, min(100, pct))
        
        # 傳送電壓資料到主控台
        lab.send(volt=v, percent=pct)
        print("Battery:", v, "V (", pct, "%)")
        
        # 繪製電池外框與正極頭
        lab.display.rect(14, 40, 100, 36, lab.display.WHITE)
        lab.display.fill_rect(114, 52, 6, 12, lab.display.WHITE)
        
        # 填充電量長條（依電量改變顏色）
        bar_w = int(96 * pct / 100)
        bar_c = lab.display.GREEN if pct > 30 else lab.display.RED
        if bar_w > 0:
            lab.display.fill_rect(16, 42, bar_w, 32, bar_c)
            
        lab.display.text("{:.2f}V ({}%)".format(v, pct), 24, 90, lab.display.YELLOW)
    else:
        lab.display.text("No Battery/USB", 12, 60, lab.display.RED)
        print("Battery reading unavailable")
        
    lab.display.show()
    lab.sleep(1)

# 取得 Wi-Fi 訊號 dBm 並畫出 4 格階梯指示條
while lab.running():
    rssi = lab.rssi()
    lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.text("WIFI SIGNAL", 20, 12, lab.display.CYAN)
    
    if rssi is not None:
        # 訊號評級：-55 以上 4 格、-65 以上 3 格、-75 以上 2 格、更弱 1 格
        if rssi >= -55: bars = 4
        elif rssi >= -65: bars = 3
        elif rssi >= -75: bars = 2
        elif rssi >= -85: bars = 1
        else: bars = 0
        
        lab.send(wifi_rssi=rssi)
        print("WiFi RSSI:", rssi, "dBm, Bars:", bars)
        
        # 繪製 4 根漸高訊號柱
        for i in range(4):
            bx = 24 + i * 22
            bh = (i + 1) * 14
            by = 88 - bh
            c = lab.display.GREEN if i < bars else lab.display.BLUE
            lab.display.fill_rect(bx, by, 16, bh, c)
            lab.display.rect(bx, by, 16, bh, lab.display.WHITE)
            
        lab.display.text("{} dBm".format(rssi), 36, 100, lab.display.YELLOW)
    else:
        lab.display.text("DISCONNECTED", 16, 60, lab.display.RED)
        print("WiFi not connected")
        
    lab.display.show()
    lab.sleep(1)

# 每 0.2 秒送出正弦波數值並在螢幕上繪製滾動折線圖
import math

angle = 0.0
history = [64] * 128

while lab.running():
    # 計算正弦波數值（-1.0 ~ 1.0）並對應至螢幕 Y 座標
    val = math.sin(angle)
    y = int(64 - val * 35)
    
    # 滾動歷史資料佇列
    history.pop(0)
    history.append(y)
    
    # 送出感測值供前端圖表繪製
    lab.send(wave=val)
    
    # 繪製畫面
    lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.text("SINE WAVE", 28, 8, lab.display.CYAN)
    lab.display.hline(0, 64, 128, lab.display.BLUE)
    
    # 連接相鄰點畫出波形折線
    for i in range(127):
        lab.display.line(i, history[i], i + 1, history[i + 1], lab.display.GREEN)
        
    lab.display.text("Val: {:.2f}".format(val), 28, 110, lab.display.YELLOW)
    lab.display.show()
    
    angle += 0.25
    lab.sleep(0.05)

# 讀取 GPIO16 光敏電阻類比值並繪製即時亮度光條
from machine import ADC, Pin

# 初始化 ADC（衰減設定為 11dB 可讀滿量程 0~3.3V）
ldr = None
try:
    ldr = ADC(Pin(16), atten=ADC.ATTN_11DB)
except Exception as e:
    print("ADC Init error:", e)

while lab.running():
    raw_val = 0
    if ldr is not None:
        try:
            raw_val = ldr.read_u16()
        except Exception as e:
            print("Read error:", e)
            
    # 換算為 0~100% 亮度比例
    pct = int(raw_val * 100 // 65535)
    lab.send(light=pct, raw_adc=raw_val)
    print("LDR light level:", pct, "% (ADC:", raw_val, ")")
    
    # 螢幕繪製
    lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.text("LIGHT SENSOR", 16, 14, lab.display.CYAN)
    lab.display.text("PIN: GPIO16", 20, 30, lab.display.WHITE)
    
    # 繪製量測外框與進度條
    lab.display.rect(14, 52, 100, 26, lab.display.WHITE)
    bar_w = int(96 * pct / 100)
    if bar_w > 0:
        lab.display.fill_rect(16, 54, bar_w, 22, lab.display.YELLOW)
        
    lab.display.text("{}% ({})".format(pct, raw_val), 18, 92, lab.display.GREEN)
    lab.display.show()
    lab.sleep(0.1)

# 透過滑桿 s1 控制 GPIO17 伺服馬達並在螢幕顯示儀表指針
from machine import Pin, PWM
import math

# 初始化 GPIO17 PWM 50Hz (週期 20ms)
servo = None
try:
    servo = PWM(Pin(17), freq=50)
except Exception as e:
    print("PWM error:", e)

target_angle = 90

@lab.on_cmd
def on_cmd(cmd):
    global target_angle
    if cmd.get("op") == "slider" and cmd.get("id") == "s1":
        # 將 0~100 滑桿映射到 0~180 度
        val = int(cmd.get("v", 50))
        target_angle = int(val * 180 / 100)
        print("Servo target angle:", target_angle)

while lab.running():
    # 角度 0~180 度對應 duty_u16 約 1638 ~ 8192
    duty = int(1638 + (target_angle / 180) * (8192 - 1638))
    if servo is not None:
        servo.duty_u16(duty)
        
    # 螢幕儀表板繪製
    lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.text("SERVO MONITOR", 12, 10, lab.display.CYAN)
    lab.display.text("Angle: {} deg".format(target_angle), 14, 28, lab.display.YELLOW)
    
    # 繪製半圓形刻度盤與指針
    cx, cy = 64, 95
    lab.display.rect(14, 50, 100, 56, lab.display.BLUE)
    rad = math.radians(180 - target_angle)
    px = int(cx + 36 * math.cos(rad))
    py = int(cy - 36 * math.sin(rad))
    lab.display.line(cx, cy, px, py, lab.display.RED)
    lab.display.fill_rect(cx - 2, cy - 2, 5, 5, lab.display.WHITE)
    
    lab.display.show()
    lab.sleep(0.05)

# 根據鏡頭人臉座標帶動螢幕準心跟隨，無人臉時平滑回正
target_x = 64.0
target_y = 64.0
cur_x = 64.0
cur_y = 64.0
has_face = False

@lab.on_cmd
def on_cmd(cmd):
    global target_x, target_y, has_face
    if cmd.get("op") == "vision" and cmd.get("mode") == "face":
        box = cmd.get("box", [])
        if len(box) >= 4:
            # box 為 [x, y, w, h] 0.0~1.0 正規化座標
            fx = box[0] + box[2] / 2.0
            fy = box[1] + box[3] / 2.0
            # 鏡頭水平鏡像轉換符合直覺
            target_x = (1.0 - fx) * 128.0
            target_y = fy * 128.0
            has_face = True
            return
    has_face = False
    target_x = 64.0
    target_y = 64.0

while lab.running():
    # 內插平滑逼近目標位置
    cur_x += (target_x - cur_x) * 0.3
    cur_y += (target_y - cur_y) * 0.3
    
    lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.text("FACE TRACKER", 16, 8, lab.display.CYAN)
    
    ix, iy = int(cur_x), int(cur_y)
    box_c = lab.display.GREEN if has_face else lab.display.BLUE
    
    # 繪製瞄準鎖定框與準星十字線

    lab.display.line(ix - 24, iy, ix + 24, iy, box_c)
    lab.display.line(ix, iy - 24, ix, iy + 24, box_c)

# 左右鍵控制底盤接球小遊戲，漏接 3 次遊戲結束
from machine import Pin
import random

btn_l = Pin(0, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_UP)
btn_r = Pin(47, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_UP)

paddle_x = 48
ball_x = 64
ball_y = 10
ball_speed = 3
score = 0
misses = 0

while lab.running():
    # 讀取按鈕並移動接球盤
    if btn_l.value() == 0:
        paddle_x = max(0, paddle_x - 5)
    if btn_r.value() == 0:
        paddle_x = min(96, paddle_x + 5)
        
    if misses < 3:
        # 掉落小球
        ball_y += ball_speed
        
        # 檢查是否接住小球

                ball_x = random.randint(10, 118)

                print("Catch! Score:", score)
            else:
                misses += 1
                ball_x = random.randint(10, 118)

        # 畫底盤

        lab.display.text("GAME OVER", 28, 40, lab.display.RED)
        lab.display.text("Score: {}".format(score), 32, 64, lab.display.YELLOW)

        ped_requested = True
        print("Pedestrian button pressed!")
        # 若目前為綠燈且剩餘時間大於 1 秒，提早進入黃燈
        if state == "GREEN" and timer > 1.0:
            timer = 1.0
            
    # 狀態轉換計時
    timer -= 0.1
    if timer <= 0:
        if state == "RED":
            state = "GREEN"
            timer = 3.0
            ped_requested = False
        elif state == "GREEN":
            state = "YELLOW"
            timer = 1.0
        elif state == "YELLOW":
            state = "RED"
            timer = 3.0
        print("Light changed to:", state)
        
    # 繪製紅綠燈箱與號誌燈
    lab.display.fill(lab.display.BLACK)
    lab.display.rect(44, 14, 40, 100, lab.display.WHITE)
    
    c_red = lab.display.RED if state == "RED" else lab.display.BLACK
    c_yel = lab.display.YELLOW if state == "YELLOW" else lab.display.BLACK
    c_grn = lab.display.GREEN if state == "GREEN" else lab.display.BLACK
    
    lab.display.fill_rect(52, 22, 24, 24, c_red)
    lab.display.fill_rect(52, 52, 24, 24, c_yel)
    lab.display.fill_rect(52, 82, 24, 24, c_grn)
    
    # 顯示行人請求狀態提示
    if ped_requested:
        lab.display.text("WAIT", 48, 2, lab.display.YELLOW)
        
    lab.display.show()
    lab.sleep(0.1)
